title: NIST WebBook: Sodium is Na, molecular weight 22.98976928 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Sodium as Na, molecular weight 22.98976928 amu, CAS 7440-23-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Sodium, CAS Registry Number 7440-23-5, lists molecular formula Na and molecular weight 22.98976928 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 22.9897692809 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Na. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
